tools.name: detect_language
tools.description: Detect the programming language of a code snippet. Returns the detected language and confidence level.

tools.name: explain_code
tools.description: Generate a natural language explanation of a code snippet including structural analysis, features, and summary.

tools.name: generate_docstring
tools.description: Generate JSDoc, Python docstring, Go godoc, or Rust doc comments for functions in the provided code.

tools.name: analyze_complexity
tools.description: Analyze code complexity including cyclomatic complexity, cognitive complexity, nesting depth, and maintainability index.

tools.name: suggest_refactor
tools.description: Get prioritized refactoring suggestions for code quality improvements.

tools.name: analyze_all
tools.description: Run all five analyses in one call: language detection, natural-language explanation, docstring generation, complexity metrics, and refactoring suggestions.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "suggest_refactor" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
